import { Box, Grid, Card, CardContent, Typography, Chip, Button, ButtonGroup } from "@mui/material";
import TrendingUpIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TrendingUp";
import TrendingDownIcon from "@mui/icons-material/TrendingDown";
import CloudIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Cloud";
import BoltIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Bolt";

// COMPLETELY NEW DESIGN - Simple, Clean, Appealing
const ForecastPageNew = () => {
    return (
        <Box>
            {/* HERO SECTION - Big, Bold Numbers */}
            <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mb: 4 }}>
                {/* Metric Card 1 */}
                <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
                    <Card
                        sx={{
                            background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #003DA5 0%, #0052D6 100%)",
                            color: "white",
                            height: "100%",
                        }}
                    >
                        <CardContent>
                            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start">
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.9, mb: 1 }}>
                                        Current Stockpile
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="h3" fontWeight={700}>
                                        34,580
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>
                                        Kilotonnes
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <BoltIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, opacity: 0.3 }} />
                            </Box>
                            <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1} mt={2}>
                                <TrendingUpIcon fontSize="small" />
                                <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={600}>
                                    +2.3% from yesterday
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>

                {/* Metric Card 2 */}
                <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
                    <Card
                        sx={{
                            background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #FFD100 0%, #FFE14D 100%)",
                            color: "#003DA5",
                            height: "100%",
                        }}
                    >
                        <CardContent>
                            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start">
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.9, mb: 1 }}>
                                        7-Day Forecast
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="h3" fontWeight={700}>
                                        36,120
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>
                                        Kilotonnes
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <TrendingUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, opacity: 0.3 }} />
                            </Box>
                            <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1} mt={2}>
                                <TrendingUpIcon fontSize="small" />
                                <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={600}>
                                    +4.5% projected growth
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>

                {/* Metric Card 3 */}
                <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
                    <Card sx={{ height: "100%", bgcolor: "#F5F7FA" }}>
                        <CardContent>
                            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start">
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                                        Model Accuracy
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="h3" fontWeight={700} color="#4CAF50">
                                        96.8%
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                        Last 30 days
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box
                                    sx={{
                                        width: 56,
                                        height: 56,
                                        borderRadius: "50%",
                                        bgcolor: "rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.1)",
                                        display: "flex",
                                        alignItems: "center",
                                        justifyContent: "center",
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <Typography variant="h6" color="#4CAF50" fontWeight={700}>
                                        A+
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                            <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1} mt={2}>
                                <Chip label="EXCELLENT" size="small" color="success" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} />
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>

                {/* Metric Card 4 */}
                <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
                    <Card sx={{ height: "100%", bgcolor: "#F5F7FA" }}>
                        <CardContent>
                            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start">
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
                                        Weather Impact
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="h3" fontWeight={700} color="#FF9800">
                                        HIGH
                                    </Typography>
                                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                                        Next 48 hours
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <CloudIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: "#FF9800", opacity: 0.3 }} />
                            </Box>
                            <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1} mt={2}>
                                <Chip label="RAIN EXPECTED" size="small" color="warning" sx={{ fontWeight: 700 }} />
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>

            {/* TIME RANGE SELECTOR */}
            <Box sx={{ mb: 3, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <Typography variant="h5" fontWeight={700}>
                    Forecast Trends
                </Typography>
                <ButtonGroup variant="outlined">
                    <Button variant="contained">7 Days</Button>
                    <Button>30 Days</Button>
                    <Button>90 Days</Button>
                </ButtonGroup>
            </Box>

            {/* MAIN CHART */}
            <Grid container spacing={3}>
                <Grid item xs={12} lg={8}>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                            <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={700} gutterBottom>
                                Stockpile Prediction
                            </Typography>
                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    height: 400,
                                    display: "flex",
                                    alignItems: "center",
                                    justifyContent: "center",
                                    bgcolor: "#F8F9FA",
                                    borderRadius: 2,
                                    mt: 2,
                                }}
                            >
                                <Typography variant="h6" color="text.secondary">
                                    📈 Chart will load here with real data
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>

                {/* QUICK INSIGHTS */}
                <Grid item xs={12} lg={4}>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                            <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={700} gutterBottom>
                                Quick Insights
                            </Typography>

                            <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                                {[
                                    { label: "Peak Demand Expected", value: "Tomorrow 14:00", color: "#FF9800" },
                                    { label: "Lowest Stock Level", value: "In 5 days", color: "#F44336" },
                                    { label: "Optimal Restock Window", value: "Next Tuesday", color: "#4CAF50" },
                                    { label: "Weather Disruption Risk", value: "Medium", color: "#FF9800" },
                                ].map((insight, index) => (
                                    <Box
                                        key={index}
                                        sx={{
                                            p: 2,
                                            mb: 2,
                                            bgcolor: "#F8F9FA",
                                            borderRadius: 2,
                                            borderLeft: `4px solid ${insight.color}`,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" gutterBottom>
                                            {insight.label}
                                        </Typography>
                                        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight={700}>
                                            {insight.value}
                                        </Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                ))}
                            </Box>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>

            {/* WEATHER SECTION */}
            <Grid container spacing={3} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <Grid item xs={12}>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent sx={{ p: 3 }}>
                            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                                <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={700}>
                                    Weather Intelligence
                                </Typography>
                                <Chip label="UPDATED 5 MIN AGO" size="small" color="success" />
                            </Box>
                            <Grid container spacing={2}>
                                {[
                                    { day: "Today", temp: "22°C", condition: "Sunny", impact: "Low" },
                                    { day: "Tomorrow", temp: "18°C", condition: "Rain", impact: "High" },
                                    { day: "Wed", temp: "20°C", condition: "Cloudy", impact: "Medium" },
                                    { day: "Thu", temp: "23°C", condition: "Sunny", impact: "Low" },
                                    { day: "Fri", temp: "21°C", condition: "Partly Cloudy", impact: "Low" },
                                ].map((weather, index) => (
                                    <Grid item xs={12} sm={6} md={2.4} key={index}>
                                        <Box
                                            sx={{
                                                p: 2,
                                                bgcolor: "#F8F9FA",
                                                borderRadius: 2,
                                                textAlign: "center",
                                                border: weather.impact === "High" ? "2px solid #FF9800" : "1px solid #E0E0E0",
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={700} gutterBottom>
                                                {weather.day}
                                            </Typography>
                                            <CloudIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32, color: "#003DA5", my: 1 }} />
                                            <Typography variant="h6" fontWeight={700}>
                                                {weather.temp}
                                            </Typography>
                                            <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                                                {weather.condition}
                                            </Typography>
                                            <Chip
                                                label={`${weather.impact} Impact`}
                                                size="small"
                                                sx={{
                                                    mt: 1,
                                                    fontSize: "0.65rem",
                                                    height: 20,
                                                    bgcolor:
                                                        weather.impact === "High"
                                                            ? "#FF9800"
                                                            : weather.impact === "Medium"
                                                                ? "#FFD100"
                                                                : "#4CAF50",
                                                    color: "white",
                                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                                }}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </Grid>
                                ))}
                            </Grid>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Box>
    );
};

export default ForecastPageNew;
